import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_N = 1 << 20;
    static final int MAX_MASK = 1 << 18;
    static final int NUM_P = 6;
    static final int[][] p = new int[NUM_P][NUM_P];
    static long[] F = new long[MAX_N];
    static long[] m = new long[MAX_MASK];
    static long ans = 0;
    static int nump = 0;
    static List<int[]> E = new ArrayList<>();

    static long bp(long x, long y) {
        long z = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1)
                z = (z * x) % MOD;
            x = (x * x) % MOD;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = (int) (Long.parseLong(st.nextToken()) * bp(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = n; j < 6; j++) {
                p[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; k++) {
                    List<Integer> v = Arrays.asList(i, j, k);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = ((1 << (v.get(0) * 3))
                                ^ (1 << (v.get(1) * 3 + 1))
                                ^ (1 << (v.get(2) * 3 + 2)));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {
                                m[mask] |= (1L << nump);
                            }
                        }
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    nump++;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1)
                    v = (v * p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]]) % MOD;
                else
                    v = (v * (MOD + 1 - p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]])) % MOD;
            }
            F[(int) m[mask]] = (F[(int) m[mask]] + v) % MOD;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); mask++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    F[mask] = (F[mask] + F[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            m[i] = 0;
        }
        nump = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; k++) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < 6; ii++) {
                        if (ii != i && ii != j && ii != k)
                            v.add(ii);
                    }
                    do {
                        int mask1 = ((1 << (v.get(0) * 3))
                                ^ (1 << (v.get(1) * 3 + 1))
                                ^ (1 << (v.get(2) * 3 + 2)));
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {
                                m[mask] |= (1L << nump);
                            }
                        }
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    nump++;
                }
            }
        }

        E.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 3; j < 6; j++) {
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1)
                    v = (v * p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]]) % MOD;
                else
                    v = (v * (MOD + 1 - p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]])) % MOD;
            }
            long temp = (1 - F[(int) ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ (int) m[mask]] + MOD) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + v * temp) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1))
            i--;
        if (i < 0)
            return false;
        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i))
            j--;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = v.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(v, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
